# DSH Workspace Settings
**English** | 简体中文

A plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** that saves session defaults **per workspace**. Each
workspac

e can carry its own agent mode, permission preset, model, reasoning effort — and,
for the Chat trans

cript, its own work-details level and collapse timing. New sessions in a
workspace start from that w

orkspace's values instead of one global setting, while in-session
choices keep winning.

Built on the official DSH UI primitives: the Workspace Settings dialog uses the host
`Modal` / `Menu

` / `Button` / `Input` components and the same row geometry as the built-in
General Settings page. C
hanges apply immediately; there is no Save/Cancel step.
## Features

- **Workspace menu entry** — each workspace row's `...` menu gains a **Workspace settings**
item abo

ve Rename / Delete. Right-clicking the workspace row opens the same official menu.
- **Settings page

** — Settings → **Workspace settings** lists every workspace with a summary
of its overrides and an

Edit action.
- **Six per-workspace defaults**:
| Setting | Values |

| Mode | any installed Agent preset, or the global default |
| Permissions | any configured permissi

on preset, or the global default |
| Model | any routable model, or the global default |
| Effort |

reasoning effort of the chosen model |
| Work details | Compact / Standard / Detailed / Verbose, or

the global value |
| Collapse timing | On completion / On next message, or the global value |

- **Automatic inheritance** — a new or reused blank session in the workspace receives the
stored mod

e, permission preset, model and reasoning effort. The workspace model plus its
effort is recorded as

the session's selection immediately, so the composer shows both
before the first message instead of

keeping the global default. In-session overrides still
win: the plugin only replaces values that st

ill look global-default- or workspace-derived.
- **Official labels** — built-in presets and permissi

ons render as **Standard mode / PTC mode
/ Minimal mode / Creator mode** and **Read Only / Workspace

Write / Full access / Auto
review**, never as machine keys such as `standard` or `workspace-write`.

- **Immediate save** — every selector writes on change, exactly like General Settings;
closing the

dialog keeps what you picked and only failures are surfaced.
- **Native chrome** — the menu, modal,

selectors and settings rows reuse the host primitives
and theme tokens, so light/dark switching and

future theme changes apply automatically.
- **Native model picker** — the model field uses a searcha

ble, provider-grouped menu with a
bounded height and sticky provider headings, matching the composer

's model picker; long
third-party catalogs no longer overflow the viewport.
- **Local and quiet** —

settings live in one JSON file under the DSH home; no telemetry and
no network requests.
## Requirements

- **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** with the Web UI and plugin support. Developed and verified
against DSH

`0.2.1-rc.3` (desktop profile).
- **Recommended DSH version:** `0.2.1-rc.3`; supported range: `>=0.2

.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`
(declared as `engines.dsh` in `package.json`).
- The plugin is ESM (`"type": "modu

le"`) and loads `react` plus the host UI primitives from
the running DSH client; no runtime dependen

cies are bundled.
- A Chromium-based DSH Web UI is required (the plugin does not render in CLI-only

compositions).
- `node` is only needed for the offline checks.
### What happens on save

There is no Save button: each change is persisted immediately. The dialog only reports
failures. Clo
sing it through `×`, Escape or the backdrop keeps the last accepted changes.

When a session is created (or a blank session is reused) in that workspace, the Host applies
the sto

n is created (or a blank session is reused) in that workspace, the Host applies
the stored defaults:

- **Mode** via the official agent-preset switch, only while the session is still blank.
- **Permissi

ons** via the official permission-preset setter; the standard Session events are
recorded.
- **Model

+ effort** as a first-request override; from the second model request on, the
session's own model s

elector is authoritative again.
- **Work details / collapse timing** through the official Chat prese

ntation preference while
a session from that workspace is active; the global value is restored when

eference while
a session from that workspace is active; the global value is restored when you leave.

Sessions that already started a turn are never rewritten. Subagent and forked sessions are
skipped.

Explicit user choices in a blank session are respected by comparing the current
value with the globa
l default and the last workspace-applied value.
## How it works
Two halves ship in one bundle:

- **`index.js`** — host half. Owns the JSON store, exposes two authenticated POST routes
(`/api/work

space-settings/catalog`, `/api/workspace-settings/save`), and listens to
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

- The plugin makes no network requests; all defaults are local files.
- No credentials, session cont

ents or personal data are collected.
- The plugin adds no telemetry.
- The Chat preference switching

only rewrites the same `ui-chat` profile values General
Settings would write, and restores your glo
bal baseline when leaving.
## Limitations

- DSH 0.2.1 has no workspace-menu extension slot. The plugin therefore intercepts the
workspace row'

s `...` menu and re-renders it with the **official** `Menu` primitive. If a
future DSH release expos

es a native slot, this should move there.
- Model/effort defaults only affect the first model reques

t of a new session; that keeps the
in-session model selector fully authoritative afterwards.
- Work

details / collapse timing are presentation preferences without a per-session API, so
they are applie

d by switching the official global preference while the workspace session
is active (see above).
- O

ther General Settings (appearance, language, link opening, performance usage, privacy
options) remai

n global.
- This is a local/experimental plugin, not an official DeepSeek product.
